events.title: Metro Hub Office Hours
events.description: Hosted by Lulu Dawson, Hub Navigator, Metro Region Innovation Hub  Lulu Dawson is a Hub Navigator at the Metro Region Innovation Hub, a regional organization supporting entrepreneurs across industries and at every stage of business. The Hub helps founders navigate the startup ecosystem by connecting them to relevant programs, mentors, funding pathways, and community resources across the Portland metro region.  As a navigator, Lulu works one-on-one with founders to understand where they are, surface what they need most right now, and connect them to the right people, resources, and opportunities to move forward. These office hours are designed to help founders gain clarity, reduce overwhelm, and leave knowing their next best steps.  Office hours are not advisory sessions — they are focused on navigation, connection, and ecosystem support.  What You Can Use Office Hours For:  Founders come to office hours to get connected around: Clarifying their stage and immediate priorities Understanding which resources or programs fit their needs Navigating funding pathways, grants, and accelerators Connecting to mentors, advisors, and service providers Finding relevant communities, networks, and peer support Exploring customer, traction, or growth challenges Navigating pivots, transitions, or moments of uncertainty Mapping realistic next steps when things feel unclear  Who Should Attend:  Kiln members and founders across any industry or stage who want help navigating what’s available, who to talk to next, and how to move forward with more clarity and confidence.  Come with questions. Leave with direction and momentum.
